Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BRIC THSTI Junior Data Scientist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being recruited for?
faq.answer: BRIC THSTI is recruiting for the post of Junior Data Scientist. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Data Scientist position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility criteria for the Junior Data Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a B.Tech./M.Sc./M.Tech. in Computer Science/Data Science/Statistics/Biostatistics/Applied Mathematics or a B.Sc. with 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Data Scientist post is 30 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at BRIC THSTI, Faridabad, Haryana, 121001. Please refer to the official notification for the exact venue address.
